critical.issue: No guard against cancelling an appointment that is already cancelled. Re-cancel returns 200 and re-runs side effects: client.late_cancels incremented again (1->2), cancellation WhatsApp re-sent, 'Anticipo ...' notification duplicated, waitlist re-notified, deposit_next re-set. Reproduced via API on a late-cancelled appt. Agenda dialog still shows Cancelar/No asistió/Atendida buttons for cancelled appts (week view), so staff can trigger this from UI.

minor.issue: status no_show / confirmed also allowed on a cancelled appointment (no state-transition validation in engine.set_status)
All 104 seeded completed bellavida appointments have no 'commission' field, so Comisiones page shows Q0.00 commission for every stylist in the current period (seed-data issue, not D6 logic)

ui_bugs.issue: Action buttons (Atendida disabled/enabled, No asistió, Cancelar) and reschedule form are rendered for status=cancelled; should be hidden like for completed
After a successful sale the payment rows keep the old amount (e.g. 30) while total resets to Q0.00, showing red 'Pagado Q30.00 de Q0.00' error; reset payment rows after sale

issues: After booking the page does not scroll to the success card; success-title/deposit deadline end up above the viewport so the client may miss 'Reserva pendiente de anticipo'
Cancelled appointments are hidden in day/month views (only week view shows them), so appt-cancel-type is only reachable from week view

Inventory: reset PaymentRows after counter sale
Portal: scroll to booking-success after booking

rca of the issue: Double-cancel: engine.set_status(status='cancelled') never checks a['status']=='cancelled'; it recomputes cancel_preview and re-runs $inc late_cancels, wa_send, notify_company and notify_waitlist. ApptDialog only hides actions for status 'completed'. Repro: book tomorrow Balayage, mark deposit, POST status cancelled apply_policy true twice -> client.late_cancels=2, 2 cancellation WA messages, 2 notifications. Fix: early raise BookingError('La cita ya está cancelada') when a['status']=='cancelled' and status=='cancelled' (and block no_show/completed from cancelled), and hide buttons in UI.
